chunks: Regarding a man who performs salat (prayer) while gesturing on his riding animal, wearing a turban, he said: “He should uncover the place of sajdah (prostration).”
As for the face-covering, that which indicates that it is not permissible is what he narrated:
Muḥammad ibn Yaʿqūb, from Muḥammad ibn Yaḥyā, from Aḥmad ibn Muḥammad, from ʿAlī ibn al-Nuʿmān, from one who narrated it, from Abī ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام: concerning...

key_terms.اللِّثَامُ: the face-covering or veil over the mouth/face
key_terms.يُومِئُ: gestures, indicating the motions of prayer without full physical performance

ai.seo_question: Is it permissible to perform salat (prayer) while covering the face or while riding an animal?
ai.summary: This passage addresses a legal ruling related to salat (prayer), specifically the condition of the face and place of sajdah (prostration) while praying in an unusual circumstance such as on a riding animal. It also introduces a related report indicating the impermissibility of praying with a face-covering.
